original: でも、本当だったら大変じゃないか。\n確かめに行ってみようよ
traducao: But what if it's true?\nLet's go check it out!

original: はっ。\nんな事言って、な〜んにもなかったら\nどうするつもりだ？
traducao: Hah.\nAnd what will you do\nif there's nothing there?

original: 大体、根拠が噂だけじゃ\n誰も動いちゃくれねえぜ
traducao: Besides, nobody's gonna move\nbased on some random rumor.

original: わたしはシングを信じるよ。\nシングが行くなら、わたしも手伝う
traducao: I believe in Shing.\nIf Shing goes, I'll help too.

original: ぐっ、コハク……
traducao: Ugh, Kohaku...

original: それに、その話が本当だったら\nたくさんの人が傷付く……
traducao: Besides, if the story is true,\nmany people will get hurt...

original: そんなの見てられないよ
traducao: I can't just stand by and watch.

original: ○○、いいところに！
traducao: ○○, perfect timing!

original: あのさ……
traducao: Hey, um...

original: おい。\nこのバカの言う事\n真に受けるんじゃねーぞ、○○
traducao: Hey.\nDon't take what this idiot\nsays seriously, ○○.

original: もう、お兄ちゃん！
traducao: Jeez, Hisui!

original: ○○、\n良かったらシングの話を\n聞いてくれない？
traducao: ○○,\nwould you mind listening\nto what Shing has to say?

original: きみの力を貸してほしいの
traducao: We need your help.

original: クエスト「本当は怖〜いおとぎ話」が\nエントリーされました。\nシングから受ける事が出来ます
traducao: Quest "The Truly Scary Fairy Tale"\nhas been registered.\nYou can accept it from Shing.

original: 力を貸してくれるんだね？\nありがとう！
traducao: You'll help us?\nThank you!

original: ったく……、お前も物好きな奴だな。\nこんな馬鹿に付き合う気が知れねぇぜ
traducao: Jeez... you're a curious one.\nI don't know why you indulge this idiot.

original: お兄ちゃん？\nそんな言い方しないの
traducao: Hisui?\nDon't speak like that.

original: せっかく協力してくれるんだから……
traducao: Since they're offering to help...

original: ……仲良くしなきゃ、ダメだよ？
traducao: ...you have to play nice, okay?

original: も、もちろんですとも……
traducao: S-Sure thing...

original: 今日もコハクの蹴りは\nキレがいいなぁ……
traducao: Kohaku's kicks are as sharp\nas ever today...

original: ここが、噂の森か……
traducao: So this is the rumored forest...

original: ほんとにいるのかねぇ……。\n「おとぎ話の魔物」なんてモンがよ
traducao: Is it really here...?\nA "monster from a fairy tale"?

original: 「火のない所は火事にならぬ」って\n言うだろ？
traducao: They say "where there's no fire,\nthere's no fire," right?

original: きっと、噂の根拠になった\n何かがあるはずだよ
traducao: There must be something here\nthat started the rumor.

original: みんな、油断せずに行こう
traducao: Let's keep our guard up, everyone.

original: それを言うなら\n「火のない所に煙は立たぬ」だろッ
traducao: You mean "where there's smoke,\nthere's fire"!

original: うん、油断禁物だよね
traducao: Yeah, we can't let our guard down.

original: 行こう！
traducao: Let's go!

original: って、オイ
traducao: Hey, wait!

original: 俺を置いて行くんじゃねえ！！
traducao: Don't leave me behind!!

original: つーかよぉ、そもそも\n「おとぎ話に出てくる魔物」って\nどんな奴なんだ？
traducao: Anyway, what exactly is\na "monster from a fairy tale"\nsupposed to be?

original: 見た目とか、能力とか、\n具体的にはどんな化け物なんだよ？
traducao: Like, what does it look like,\nor what kind of powers does it have?

original: 夢を食べる恐ろしい魔物だって、\nお話には書いてあったよ
traducao: The story says it's a terrifying monster\nthat eats dreams.

original: 人の夢の中に棲んで、\n人の夢を食べちゃうんだって。\n詳しい事は、わからないけど……
traducao: It lives inside people's dreams\nand eats them.\nI don't know the exact details...

original: 夢なんて食べて、美味しいのかな？
traducao: Are dreams even tasty?

original: それに、夢を食べられたら、\n夢を見てた人は\nどうなっちゃうんだろう
traducao: And what happens to the person\nwhose dream is eaten\nby the monster?

original: 心を失ってしまうみたい
traducao: It seems they lose their heart.

original: 心がなくなっちゃうなんて、怖いね……。\n笑う事も、泣く事も、\n出来なくなっちゃうってコトだもん
traducao: Losing your heart is scary...\nIt means you won't be able\nto laugh or cry anymore.

original: 大丈夫だ、コハク
traducao: It's okay, Kohaku.

original: コハクは何があっても、\n兄ちゃんが守ってやるからな！
traducao: No matter what happens,\nI'll protect you, Kohaku!

original: お兄ちゃん……
traducao: Hisui...

original: うん。\nありがとう
traducao: Yeah.\nThanks.

original: オレだって！
traducao: Me too!

original: 何があっても、コハクを守るよ！！
traducao: I'll protect Kohaku no matter what!!

original: うん。\nシングも、ありがとう
traducao: Yeah.\nThanks to you too, Shing.

original: よ〜し、よく言ったシング。\nいざって時は、お前を一番\n頼りにしてるぜ
traducao: Alright, well said, Shing.\nIf push comes to shove,\nI'm counting on you the most.

original: ヒスイ……。\nオレの事、認めてくれたの？
traducao: Hisui...\nAre you finally acknowledging me?

original: お前が襲われてる間に、\n俺がコハクをきちんと逃がす
traducao: While you're getting attacked,\nI'll safely help Kohaku escape.

original: 安心しろ。\nお前の死は無駄にしねえからな
traducao: Rest assured.\nYour death won't be in vain.

original: ちょ、ちょっと。\nオレは初めから生贄要員なの！？
traducao: H-Hey!\nAm I just a sacrifice from the start!?

original: もし「おとぎ話の魔物」が\n本当にいるならさ……
traducao: If the "fairy tale monster"\nreally exists...

original: お話に出てくる「ねむり姫」も\nどこかにいるって事なのかな？
traducao: Does that mean "Sleeping Beauty"\nfrom the story exists somewhere too?

original: はっ。\nそんな事あるわけ……
traducao: Hah.\nThere's no way that...

original: わたしはいると思うな。\nエメラルドの髪のねむり姫……
traducao: I think she does.\nSleeping Beauty with emerald hair...

original: 「いばらの森」の奥で、まだ\n世界が消える夢を見てる気がする。\n千年経った今も、ずっと……
traducao: Deep in the "briar forest," I feel like\nshe's still dreaming of the world ending.\nEven now, after a thousand years...

original: おいおい。　ありゃおとぎ話だぜ？\n千年も寝こけてるお姫さんなんざ\n本当にいるわけ……
traducao: Hey now. It's just a fairy tale.\nThere's no way a princess\nsleeping for a thousand years exists...

original: いるよ！　きっといる
traducao: She does! I'm sure she does.

original: わたし、小さい頃、何度か夢に見たの
traducao: I dreamt of her often when I was little.

original: 偶然かもしれないけど……。\nそれから、どうしても彼女のこと……
traducao: It might be a coincidence...\nBut I can't stop thinking about her...

original: コハク……
traducao: Kohaku...

original: うん。\nコハクがいるって思うなら、\nオレはやっぱり、いるんだって思う
traducao: Yeah.\nIf Kohaku believes she exists,\nthen I believe she exists too.

original: その方が、ロマンだってあるしね！
traducao: It's more romantic that way!

original: シング……
traducao: Shing...

original: いばらの森のねむり姫、ねぇ……
traducao: Sleeping Beauty in the briars, huh...

original: ま、確かに……いるんなら\n目覚めさせてやりたいとは思うけどよ
traducao: Well, if she really does exist,\nI'd want to wake her up.

original: たった一人でそんな悪夢を\n見続けるなんて、キツいだろうな
traducao: Having nightmares all alone like that\nmust be pretty rough.

original: へぇ〜。\nヒスイって、何だかんだ言っても\nねむり姫の事が好きなんだね
traducao: Wow.\nEven after all you said, Hisui,\nyou still like Sleeping Beauty.

original: はぁ？\nんな事あるわけねーだろッ！
traducao: Huh?\nNo way in hell!

original: 俺がラブなのは、後にも先にも\nコハクだけだぜ
traducao: The only one I'll ever love\nis Kohaku.

original: 後にも先にも……なんだ
traducao: Ever love... huh.

original: お兄ちゃん……
traducao: Hisui...

original: ……おい。\n二人して痛々しい目で\nこっち見るなよッッ！！？
traducao: ...Hey.\nDon't look at me with those\npitying eyes!!?

original: 本気で俺が危ないヤツ\nみてぇだろッ！！
traducao: You're making me look\nlike a total creep!!

original: ふぅ、倒した……な
traducao: Phew, we beat it... I think.

original: 何だかよくわからねえが、\nこれで一件落着……
traducao: I'm not really sure what that was,\nbut case closed...

original: あッ！
traducao: Ah!

original: ど、どうしたのコハク？
traducao: W-What's wrong, Kohaku?

original: ……思い出したの。\nあの魔物をどこで見たのか
traducao: ...I remembered.\nWhere I've seen that monster before.

original: 伝説のユニコーンに似てるんだと思う。\nわたし達が想像してた、\nおとぎ話の魔物なんかじゃない……
traducao: I think it looks like a legendary unicorn.\nIt's not the fairy tale monster\nwe were imagining...

original: ってぇ事は……何だ？
traducao: Which means... what?

original: ヒト違いならぬ、\n魔物違いだったってワケかぁ！？
traducao: So it wasn't a case of mistaken identity,\nbut mistaken monster identity!?

original: 魔物違い、か……。\nでも、そうだよね
traducao: Mistaken monster identity, huh...\nBut it makes sense.

original: 夢を食べる魔物なんて、\n本当にいたら大変だし……
traducao: It'd be a huge problem if a monster\nthat eats dreams really existed...

original: おとぎ話はおとぎ話だったって事……かな。\nあの魔物には、ちょっと\nかわいそうな事しちゃったね……
traducao: I guess it was just a fairy tale.\nWe ended up doing something\na bit cruel to that monster...

original: そんなこたぁどうでもいいんだよッ！
traducao: Who cares about that!

original: くそっ、ここまで来て無駄骨なんて……。\nツイてねぇ……
traducao: Damn it, we came all this way for nothing.\nTalk about bad luck...

original: そうかな？　オレは……、\nオレは、無駄骨なんかじゃないと思うよ……。\nね、コハク？
traducao: You think so? I don't think...\nI don't think it was for nothing...\nRight, Kohaku?

original: うん……わたしも……。\nちょっとドキドキして楽しかったよ？
traducao: Yeah... me neither...\nIt was a bit thrilling and fun, you know?

original: 何だか、\nおとぎ話の世界に入ったみたいで……
traducao: It felt like\nwe stepped right into a fairy tale...

original: オレも……、\nコハクと冒険してるって思って\nすっごく、ドキドキした
traducao: Me too...\nThinking I was adventuring with Kohaku\nmade my heart pound.

original: シング……
traducao: Shing...

original: こらぁぁ〜〜ッ！
traducao: Hey you two~~!!

original: なぁに勝手に\nいい雰囲気になってやがるッ！？
traducao: Don't you go creating\na good atmosphere on your own!!

original: 俺は絶ッ対！\nてめぇの事は認めねえからな！
traducao: I will absolutely! NEVER!\nacknowledge you!

original: それでも……、\n時間をかけて絶ッ対わかってもらうさ
traducao: Even so...\nI'll take my time and absolutely make you!

original: ね……、コハク？
traducao: Right... Kohaku?

original: うん……頑張ろうね！　シング
traducao: Yeah... Let's do our best! Shing.

original: だから、その雰囲気を\nやめろって言ってんだ〜〜！！
traducao: I'm telling you, stop\ncreating that atmosphere~~!!

original: やっと、帰ってきたか……
traducao: We're finally back...

original: ったく、つまんねえ噂話に\n踊らされちまったもんだぜ
traducao: Jeez, letting ourselves get danced around\nby some stupid rumor.

original: でも、本当の事がわかって\n良かったじゃないか
traducao: But aren't you glad\nwe found out the truth?

original: そうだよね
traducao: You're right.

original: これで噂は落ち着くはずだし、\nみんなも安心して\n元の暮らしに戻れると思う
traducao: This should settle the rumors,\nand I think everyone can safely\nreturn to their normal lives.

original: ま、何でもいいけどよ……
traducao: Well, whatever...

original: ○○、\nお前もとんだ\nとばっちりだったとは思うが……
traducao: ○○,\nI know you got dragged into this\ncollateral damage, but...

original: ま、最後まで付き合ってくれて\nありがとうな
traducao: Well, thanks for sticking with us\nuntil the end.

original: うん。\nありがとう、○○
traducao: Yeah.\nThanks, ○○.

original: 今度はわたし達が\n○○の為に頑張るよ
traducao: Next time, we'll do our best\nfor you, ○○.

original: 困った事があったら、\nいつでも言ってね
traducao: If you ever need help,\njust say the word.

original: ドラゴン退治でも、ゾンビ退治でも\n何でも付き合うから！
traducao: Whether it's fighting dragons or zombies,\nwe'll tag along for anything!

original: ドラゴンに……ゾンビ？
traducao: Dragons... and zombies?

original: それはちょっと……
traducao: That's a bit...

original: ねえ、もしかして……。\n魔物ってアレじゃないかな？
traducao: Hey, what if...\nthat was the monster?

original: 確かに、どこかで見た様な\n姿をしてるけど……
traducao: It certainly looks like something\nwe've seen before, but...

original: あれが、おとぎ話の魔物……なの？
traducao: Is that... the fairy tale monster?

original: 話は後だ！\nアイツ、こっちに気付きやがったぞ！！
traducao: We can talk later!\nThat thing noticed us!!

original: みんな！\n油断すんじゃねーぞ！！
traducao: Everyone!\nDon't let your guard down!!

original: 今度は、\nさっきみたいには行かないぞ！
traducao: This time,\nit won't go like before!

original: ああ。\n正体はともかく、\n借りはきっちり返させてもらうぜ！
traducao: Yeah.\nWhatever it is,\nwe're paying it back in full!

original: こんな喧嘩ッ早ぇ魔物、\nいつまでも放置しておけるかよッ！！
traducao: I won't let such a short-tempered\nmonster roam free forever!!

original: うん。\nみんな、行くよ！
traducao: Yeah.\nLet's go, everyone!
